title: SQL Injection - Login Bypass
impact: Bypasses authentication controls, allowing an attacker to gain unauthorized administrative access to the application.
remediation: Use parameterized queries (prepared statements) to ensure user input is treated as data and never interpreted as SQL code.

title: SQL Injection - Data Extraction
payload_used: ')) UNION SELECT id, email, password, '4', '5', '6', '7', '8', '9' FROM Users--
impact: Allows an attacker to extract sensitive database information, including user credentials and password hashes, by appending a malicious query to a legitimate search.
remediation: Implement parameterized queries and restrict database user privileges to the minimum necessary for the application to function.

title: Reflected Cross-Site Scripting (XSS)
impact: Allows an attacker to execute arbitrary JavaScript in a victim's browser via a crafted link, potentially stealing session cookies or performing actions on behalf of the user.
remediation: Implement context-aware output encoding for all user-supplied data that is reflected back to the page.

title: Stored Cross-Site Scripting (XSS)
impact: Allows an attacker to persistently execute malicious JavaScript in the browsers of other users (including administrators) who view the affected page.
remediation: Sanitize and encode all user-supplied input before rendering it on the page, and implement a strict Content Security Policy (CSP).
